latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of nano-banana-pro image generation and editing skill using Gemini 3 Pro Image API.
- Supports both text-to-image and image-to-image workflows at 1K, 2K, and 4K resolutions.
- Detailed usage instructions for generating or editing images via command line, including API key handling.
- Includes best practices for iterative workflow: quick 1K drafts, precise prompt edits, and final 4K outputs.
- Automatic, context-aware filename generation with timestamp and description.
- Covers preflight checks, common errors, prompt handling, editing guidance, and precise prompt templates.
